page.notes: The first word of the page is a fragment and is kept as such. "T[?]raso-" has the h under a blot. The first marginal note reads "1.si" in the scan, which may be "l.si"; it is given here as "l.si". The paragraph breaks are not clearly marked in the scan, so the page is kept as one continuous paragraph. The "5." and "4." numbers are part of the running text. "incusatum" is as printed. The catchword "pel-" is at the foot right and is not repeated in the text.
